securityBoundary: Every method annotated with @JavascriptInterface is callable by scripts loaded in the Android WebView. Keep this API narrow, explicit, reviewed, and data-only.

interfaces.name: ShbaceNative
interfaces.purpose: Explicit Android capabilities exposed to the local application WebView.

methods.name: copyText
methods.purpose: Copy supplied text to the Android clipboard.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.purpose: Return limited package, build, Android and device information.

methods.name: getRemoteContentManifest
methods.purpose: Read the installed remote-content manifest from app-private storage.

methods.name: getRemoteContentState
methods.purpose: Read installed and pending remote-content state.

methods.name: haptic
methods.purpose: Request one of the bounded application vibration patterns.

methods.name: keepScreenOn
methods.purpose: Set or clear the Android keep-screen-on window flag.

methods.name: openExternalUrl
methods.purpose: Open an approved GitHub HTTPS URL in the external browser.

methods.name: openRemoteContentFile
methods.purpose: Open a verified installed content file through Android FileProvider.

methods.name: printHtml
methods.purpose: Render supplied HTML in the native print flow.

methods.name: readRemoteContentBase64
methods.purpose: Read an installed remote-content file as Base64.

methods.name: readRemoteContentText
methods.purpose: Read an installed remote-content file as text.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.purpose: Save a user-requested exported file to Android Downloads.

methods.name: shareImage
methods.purpose: Share a generated image through Android's chooser.

methods.name: shareText
methods.purpose: Share supplied text through Android's chooser.

methods.name: speakText
methods.purpose: Speak supplied text through Android TextToSpeech.

methods.name: startRemoteContentRollback
methods.purpose: Request rollback to the previously retained remote-content package.

methods.name: startRemoteContentSync
methods.purpose: Request the configured remote-content update flow.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.purpose: Stop Android TextToSpeech playback.

methods.name: stopStudyTimer
methods.purpose: Stop the native foreground study-timer service.

methods.name: updateStudyTimer
methods.purpose: Update the native foreground study-timer service state.

interfaces.name: ShbaceInsets
interfaces.purpose: Read window inset information and acknowledge the existing WebView startup handshake.

methods.name: get
methods.purpose: Return the current inset data as JSON.

methods.name: ready
methods.purpose: Acknowledge the WebView readiness handshake.
